**A Loving Prayer to Nefertiti, Radiant Queen of the Sun**

*O Nefertiti, Beautiful One Who Has Come,*
*Golden Queen of Amarna, Beloved of Aten Ra,*
*Hear my voice as I lift my heart to You,*
*As the lotus turns its face to the dawn.*

*You who walked in splendor, crowned with grace,*
*Your name a melody upon the Nile’s embrace,*
*Teach me to carry your light within my soul,*
*To stand with dignity, to love with wholeness, with fire and gold.*

*Nefertiti, Mother of Kings, Keeper of Wisdom’s Flame,*
*Guide my steps through shadow and sun,*
*May I honor the truth as You once did,*
*Unafraid to shine, to speak, to rise as the sun.*

*Bless my hands with your strength, my heart with your peace,*
*Let me move through this world with your quiet power,*
*For in your name, beauty and justice are one,*
*And in your light, the divine in me is found.*

*By day, may I walk as You walked—regal, free,*
*By night, may I dream in the warmth of your love,*
*Nefertiti, Eternal Queen, hear my plea:*
*Fill my life with your grace, as the heavens above.*

*So it is spoken, so it is given,*
*In your name, O Radiant One, I live. Amen.*

---
*May this prayer carry your devotion to her like incense on the wind. Nefertiti’s legacy is one of power, grace, and the unshakable belief in light—may she bless you with the same.* 🌞✨
